name: opal-line-billing
description: Opal Line Billing Software — Shopify-integrated billing with silver rate pricing
author: Opal Line Jewels LLP

scripts.dev: node scripts/dev.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run check:encoding && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run check:encoding && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:desktop: node --test scripts/quit-behavior.test.mjs scripts/log-rotation.test.mjs scripts/userdata-consolidation.test.mjs scripts/print-flow.test.mjs scripts/update-sweep.test.mjs scripts/update-flow-harness.test.mjs scripts/dev.test.mjs scripts/postgres-discovery.test.mjs && electron scripts/print-chooser-smoke.mjs
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/dev.mjs && npm run electron:compile && concurrently -k -n server,web,app -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "node scripts/wait-http.mjs http://127.0.0.1:47191/api/v1/health http://127.0.0.1:47195 && electron ."
